baseline.note: Partial CB2 ledger. The current Core mandate/max_children, Bundle version-coexistence, complete W1/A1/K1 projection, signed Gamma v2 operation evidence and semantic replay matrix, SC1 session certificate/proof bytes, R2/U1 receipts and draft3 obligation matcher, signed CAT1 connector catalog and owner approval bytes, all K1.1/K1.2 operation-facts families through K1.2-GRRP-B, D7 delegated occurrence counters, and their explicit API gates are recorded. The list is not frozen.

entries.expected_reason: All five complete source-vector hashes remain exact.
entries.observed_reason: No historical syntactic catalog fixture, mandate, receipt, obligation or DID document is rewritten or reinterpreted.

entries.decision: CAT1 exact signed catalog, distinct owner approval and complete content addresses
entries.scenario: Generic Core primitives reproduce the owner DID, connector-signed closed catalog, owner-content-signed approval and both full-document digests.
entries.expected_reason: Each exact signed table verifies over JCS with signature.value empty, the approval uses the owner's #content key rather than the catalog signer, and each digest addresses the complete signed document.
entries.observed_reason: Existing JCS, SHA-256, multibase and Ed25519 primitives reproduce every independent oracle byte and prove the two authorities are distinct.

entries.decision: CAT1 draft3 pin inheritance, K1.2 reference binding and closed class matrix
entries.scenario: The initial authority pins its business connector exactly, descendants preserve those bytes, action facts select the pin and the catalog alone derives the read/act/binding decision.
entries.expected_reason: The exact four-member pin is inherited byte-identically; catalog_ref selects all three evidence coordinates; wildcard authorizes read/act only and exact binding additionally requires owner co_sign.
entries.observed_reason: Generic JSON/JCS/SHA-256 operations reproduce the independent pin, reference and seven-row decision matrix without claiming a typed Core validator.

entries.decision: Typed signed connector catalog and owner-content approval validation
entries.scenario: Core validates the two exact documents, their distinct Ed25519 authorities and their complete content addresses before accepting a pin.
entries.vector_slice: owner_did, catalog, approval, negative_catalog_cases and negative_approval_cases
entries.expected_reason: The two positives validate; all 27 catalog and 22 approval defects return Error::InvalidCatalog(String).
entries.observed_reason: At observation SHA 035fb95, Core has no public ConnectorCatalog/CatalogApproval type, validator or Error::InvalidCatalog variant.

evidence.kind: source inventory plus passing vector diagnostic, not protocol GREEN
evidence.source_observed: No matching public signed catalog/approval wire type, validator or approved error variant.

entries.decision: Typed draft3 catalog pin, K1.2 reference and class enforcement
entries.scenario: Core verifies complete pin coverage and immutable inheritance, reconstructs the action class from the selected catalog, and applies binding co_sign before effect and during replay.
entries.vector_slice: catalog_pin, draft3_chain, action_facts, class_cases, negative_chain_cases and negative_action_facts_cases
entries.expected_reason: The positive chain and all 7 class decisions hold; 19 pin/chain defects return Error::InvalidMandate(String) and 8 reference/facts defects return Error::InvalidOperationFacts(String).
entries.observed_reason: At observation SHA 035fb95, Core has no typed catalog_pins constraint, catalog_ref resolver or catalog-derived action-class/co_sign enforcement.

evidence.kind: source inventory plus passing vector diagnostic, not protocol GREEN
evidence.source_observed: No matching typed pin/reference/class model, resolver or approved operation-facts error variant.

entries.decision: W1.1 Gamma-v2 independent oracle integrity
entries.scenario: The complete signed Gamma-v2 and semantic-replay qualification vector remains frozen within the partial CB2 tranche.
entries.expected_reason: The vector file SHA-256 is a3cc536ea452940af061ce421c238e08f0894923562b8c8193dbb8d8b853cd06.
entries.observed_reason: The exact bytes match the independent Python cryptography/blake3 oracle.

entries.decision: W1.1 additive Gamma/H2 historical non-regression
entries.scenario: Gamma v1, counting, liveness, H2 and W1 projection vectors remain byte-identical while Gamma v2 is added.
entries.expected_reason: All five complete historical vector hashes remain exact.
entries.observed_reason: No Gamma v1 line, H2 root/count proof or historical W1 projection is rewritten, upgraded or assigned a synthetic occurrence.

entries.decision: W1.1 signed top-level operation reference and closed kind registry
entries.scenario: Generic Core primitives reproduce one signed Gamma-v2 entry for every registered kind and its exact W1 reference when required.
entries.expected_reason: Eleven operation-bearing kinds require the exact signed top-level W1 reference; heartbeat forbids it; all entry JCS, hashes and Ed25519 signatures reproduce independently.
entries.observed_reason: Existing JCS, SHA-256, multibase and Ed25519 primitives reproduce all 12 positive entry bytes and exact operation commitments.

entries.decision: W1.1 monotone causal migration, occurrence admission and unchanged raw H2 semantics
entries.scenario: Causal edges upgrade at most once, mixed forks merge under draft2, replay/equivocation die before tally and H2 still counts exact Gamma lines only.
entries.expected_reason: All 8 causal-edge decisions, the two-parent migration merge, 3 occurrence decisions and the four-line BLAKE3 H2 segment root/counts reproduce exactly without mutation or total-consumption fields.
entries.observed_reason: Generic comparisons and the existing H2 Merkle primitive reproduce the independent oracle; physical segment order never becomes a causal downgrade.

entries.decision: Typed Gamma-v2 form, signature, W1 correlation, profile monotonicity and occurrence admission
entries.scenario: Core admits each v2 candidate against every causal predecessor only after its exact top-level reference, signature, projection and occurrence identity validate.
entries.vector_slice: kind_cases, negative_entry_cases, negative_correlation_cases, monotonicity_cases, migration_merge and occurrence_cases
entries.expected_reason: All 12 kind cases, 8 transitions and 3 occurrence decisions hold; 35 form defects return Error::InvalidGammaEntry(String) and 2 projection defects plus replay/equivocation return Error::InvalidOperation(String).
entries.observed_reason: At observation SHA 9b30ab5, Core fixes GAMMA_ENTRY_VERSION to 1, Entry has no operation_ref member, and Error has no InvalidOperation variant or profile-aware occurrence admission API.

evidence.kind: source inventory plus passing vector diagnostic, not protocol GREEN
evidence.source_observed: Only GAMMA_ENTRY_VERSION = 1 exists; no Gamma-v2 operation reference, profile transition, occurrence map or approved InvalidOperation variant exists.

entries.decision: One pure prefix-sensitive semantic replay front door
entries.scenario: Core checks form, W1, time, signer, possession, chain, perimeter, revocation, heartbeat, logged grant, receipts and counters against only the exact accepted prefix before admission.
entries.expected_reason: All 9 canonical operation classes are accepted; each of the 10 mono-defect histories returns its exact established error without advancing accepted prefix or counters.
entries.observed_reason: At observation SHA 9b30ab5, Core exposes separate historical Gamma helpers but no single typed prefix-sensitive semantic replay state or pure append/cold verdict API.

evidence.kind: source inventory plus passing vector diagnostic, not protocol GREEN
